instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning single-page React TypeScript application for doitright.in based on the pitch deck theme (Rightwing: All-in-one services platform where people get what they seek). Include: 1. Navigation bar with brand logo & links + CTA button. 2. Hero section with headline, subtitle, quick stats, and primary CTA opening the Requirement Form Modal. 3. Services Showcase (Tech, Digital Marketing, Cloud Infrastructure, Strategic Consulting, Dedicated Talent, 24/7 Operations). 4. How It Works (4-step streamlined onboarding & execution flow). 5. Value Points & Trust Metrics. 6. Testimonials from enterprise leaders. 7. Requirement Form Modal with name, email, phone, service needed, preferred timeline, message, and form validation saving submissions to Supabase (or fallback storage / mock API with toast feedback). 8. Footer with quick links and copyright. Ensure all interactive elements include data-testid attributes, high accessibility contrast, and gorgeous glassmorphism UI.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all
You MUST NOT center align the app container
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute
